title: Render of Mind and Body

sources.title: Gaping Wounds
markers: lacks a check for attack rolls

summary: A +1 shortsword that deals an extra 1d8 Psychic when its attack starts with Advantage.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 1 Piercing plus Dexterity or Strength, +1 attack. Martial, one-handed, finesse, light, 5 ft melee.
fields.Psychic Steel Virtuoso: An attack with this weapon deals +1d8 Psychic when it already has Advantage before the roll. Reckless Attack does not activate it.
fields.Flourish: Bonus Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Melee attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. The effect lists Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Off Balance for 2 turns, while the action’s base save row omits the +2. Off Balance gives disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and advantage to attackers. Taking damage or Help ends it.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action, proficient main hand, once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage on hit. Constitution save vs weapon-action DC +2 prevents 2 turns of Gaping Wounds. Undead and Constructs are immune. Successful attacks add 2 Piercing in standard modes. In Honour, damage sources add 2 of their original damage type. Healing removes it.
fields.Acquisition: Lann Tarv at Moonrise Towers X −164, Y −167 after convincing Z’rell to offer additional aid.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
